title: Rescue Fest
description: October 12 was the day of the Kadena Air Base's Rescue Fest. Here's LCpl. Takoune Norasingh with the story
keywords: Oki, rescue fest, Takoune Norasingh, Dylan Crawford, AFN, Okinawa, Kadena

transcript.text: They remain with a 31st and 33rd rescue squadron specialized in combat search and rescue.
Rescue Fest is the day where they get a chance to show off what they've got.
Rescue Fest is to display our capabilities to everyone here on Okinawa and also Sophostas
So they can come out and get a little bit of taste of what we can actually do and meet
some of the guys and people that want to try to join this career field.
They can talk to the other PJs and try to get a feel for what it's like.
We can help anyone in Okinawa.
If they say there's a Japanese fishing boat off the coast where someone else can't go,
we could go out and help any injured personnel on that boat.
Rescue Fest isn't just about showing off capabilities, it's also family oriented.
Of course on Kedina every event we have to have a bouncy house.
We had rides for the kids on our ATVs and then we have a climbing wall, an indoor climbing
wall and then of course we had the demonstration of the extrication.
We had our guys showing some alternate insertion and extraction things like a hoist, fast rope,
rope ladder and things like that.
I think this one was pretty successful.
We gave people insight into what we do and we'll just have to see if we can do it again
